title: Sensitive Outputs
scenario: Outputs can carry secrets. Mark a token output sensitive so Terraform redacts it in plan and apply output while still making the value available to the caller.

focus.title: Complete the sensitive output
focus.todo: Set the value from the variable and mark the output sensitive.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `outputs.tf`. The work is inside `output "session_token"`. Set the value from the variable and mark the output sensitive. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `outputs.tf` and work only inside `output "session_token"`. Use this code shape: description; value; sensitive. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.session_token`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
